Last weekend, _Toy Story 5_) held firm in first place, pulling in just over $70 million in its sophomore frame and lifting its 10‑day total to $298.07 million. Since then, the film has cruised past the $300 million milestone, reaching $326.74 million through 13 days of release. Challenging the reigning champ this weekend is newcomer _Minions & Monsters_), which bowed on Wednesday with a $14 million opening day.
